Chapter 983: Chapter 3 Fierce Sun (Please Subscribe)

“Source World.”

Lin Yuan’s expression was solemn as he looked at the world coordinates deep within the Myriad Realms Gate.

“Now that I’ve arrived through transmigration, I no longer need to expend extra World-Breaking Origin Force.”

Lin Yuan thought to himself, since stepping into the Twelve Tiers, his life’s essence had undergone a leap, and not only did he not need World-Breaking Origin Force for worlds he had transmigrated to before.

Even for worlds he had not transmigrated to, he did not require World-Breaking Origin Force.

He just needed to have the correct world coordinates.

“It seems that the World-Breaking Origin Force expended in previous transmigrations was used to protect my True Spirit Consciousness?” Lin Yuan guessed.

As a being of the Twelve Tiers, his life’s essence was strong enough, and likewise, his True Spirit Consciousness was strong enough to not need extra protection from the Myriad Realms Gate, thereby also saving a sum of World-Breaking Origin Force.

“I still choose to transmigrate with the True Spirit Consciousness.”

Lin Yuan silently concluded.

Transmigration with the True Spirit Will, the only defect is the existence of a vulnerable period.

But this defect, with Lin Yuan’s advancement to the Twelve Tiers, had been basically remedied.

Vulnerable period? If anything, he could just return to the Myriad Realms Gate and continue the next transmigration.

After all, it didn’t require the expenditure of World-Breaking Origin Force.

And now, with Lin Yuan’s mastery over the World-Breaking Origin Force, even if he encountered some danger during the vulnerable period, he could block it.

Minor dangers could be avoided with the help of World-Breaking Origin Force.

Major dangers didn’t need to be withstood; just give up and begin the next transmigration.

As for his true self? It was stationed in the Cosmic Starry Skies, where safety is undoubtedly assured.

Especially while situated in the Xuanhuang Secret Realm, even if the universe itself crumbled, Lin Yuan could ignore it.

“Let’s begin.”

Lin Yuan immediately partitioned a portion of his True Spirit Consciousness and surged into the Myriad Realms Gate.

After reaching the Twelve Tiers, Lin Yuan’s transmigrations didn’t require the immersion of all his True Spirit Consciousness—just a part was enough. This also meant that both the body in the Cosmic Starry Skies and the body in the transmigrated world could act independently.

Moreover, he could also utilize his numerous incarnations.

“Hmm?”

“Close to one-third of the True Spirit Consciousness?”

Lin Yuan looked at the Myriad Realms Gate; at this moment, a small portion of his True Spirit Consciousness surged into the Myriad Realms Gate, descending upon that source world, ready to merge into it.

…

In a daze.

Lin Yuan’s slumbering consciousness began to awaken.

“Young master, don’t die, you must not die, it’s all my fault, if I hadn’t been careless enough to leave, you wouldn’t end up like this….”

“Dongyang Family, if anything really happens to the young master, even if my lord and lady can endure it, I won’t let you off!”

“We’re almost home, just a little further to the house, and you will be saved, young master.”

Lin Yuan’s consciousness vaguely sensed the spatial fluctuations of the outside world – clearly, someone was carrying him through a wide-range space-time travel.

“Qingfen Domain… Lord Qingfen’s fief? Lord Qingfen is a Great Lord-level existence, a lord granted by the Fierce Sun Ancient Country, terrifyingly powerful, and I am the disciple of the Yu Family with the most potential, competing for a spot as a disciple of Lord Qingfen against the Dongyang Family… To curry favor with Lord Qingfen, the Dongyang Family took the opportunity to assassinate me while I was out…”

Lin Yuan quickly assimilated a massive amount of memories flooding into his mind, understanding his current situation.

Both the Yu Family and the Dongyang Family are second-rate families within the Qingfen Domain; if they could establish a connection with Lord Qingfen, they at least had a chance of being promoted to a first-rate family.

And a first-rate family… meant an abundance of resources and status.

“Dongyang Meng…” A stunning figure flashed through Lin Yuan’s mind.

In the competition between the Yu Family and the Dongyang Family for the opportunity to be Lord Qingfen’s disciple, the one with the highest hope from the Yu Family was the original body, whereas it was Dongyang Meng for the Dongyang Family.

In reality, the original body and Dongyang Meng were on good terms secretly, and the original body even harbored admiration for Dongyang Meng.

During this most intense competition between the two families, the original body should have been hiding within the family to prevent any accidents.

But Dongyang Meng contacted him, wanting to meet and claiming to have a way to alleviate tensions between the two families as well as resolving the current strained situation of the Yu Family and the Dongyang Family.

“So, the ‘solution’ you meant was to get rid of me?”

The thought that emerged in Lin Yuan’s mind for the last time was of the original body.

Knowing that Dongyang Meng wanted to meet, the original body, against all reason, secretly snuck out of the family, bringing only an old servant with him.

After meeting Dongyang Meng and in order to ensure their conversation remained private, he even sent the old servant away.

However, what awaited the original body was an ambushing powerhouse from the Dongyang Family hiding in the shadows.

If the original body hadn’t carried numerous life-saving measures, and the old servant had not sensed something wrong and hurried back, he probably would have been completely shattered.

“My physical body and soul…” Lin Yuan could feel his current state.

At this moment, his body and soul were being eroded by a dark force, weakening swiftly.

Only deep within his body and soul was there a life-force sustaining energy, albeit the latter was clearly in retreat.

If nothing unexpected happened, in at most five breaths, the original body’s soul and flesh would be completely extinguished.

“What should I do?”

Lin Yuan felt somewhat helpless in his heart.

Just after arriving through transmigration, he hadn’t set up any methods and had no ability to resist the dark force that continued to erode.

As for the will of the spirit? The will of the spirit also required a sufficiently strong body and soul to carry and exert its power, and his spirit will couldn’t directly resist the dark erosion.

“Now…”

Lin Yuan pondered in his mind.

He had two choices now.

One was to give up immediately and have the consciousness that had transmigrated return to his true self.

However, by doing so, it would be the same as wasting this transmigration opportunity. Although Lin Yuan’s transmigration to the Source World did not exhaust any World-Breaking Origin Force, it did come with a ‘cool-down period.’

He could only arrive once every three hundred and thirty-three years.

If he gave up this time, Lin Yuan’s next descent would be three hundred and thirty-three years later.
